arxiv-1603-00306.title: Revealing the ultrafast light-to-matter energy conversion before heat diffusion in a layered Dirac semimetal
arxiv-1603-00306.creator: Y. Ishida, H. Masuda, H. Sakai, S. Ishiwata, S. Shin
arxiv-1603-00306.description: Abstract There is still no general consensus on how one can describe the out-of-equilibrium phenomena in matter induced by an ultrashort light pulse. We investigate the pulse-induced dynamics in a layered Dirac semimetal SrMnBi 2 by pump-and-probe photoemission spectroscopy. At ≲ \lesssim 1 ps, the electronic recovery slowed upon increasing the pump power.

arxiv-2107-13380.title: Renewable Energy Targets and Unintended Storage Cycling: Implications for Energy Modeling Journal: arXiv
arxiv-2107-13380.creator: Martin Kittel, Wolf-Peter Schill
arxiv-2107-13380.description: Abstract To decarbonize the economy, many governments have set targets for the use of renewable energy sources. These are often formulated as relative shares of electricity demand or supply. Implementing respective constraints in energy models is a surprisingly delicate issue. They may cause a modeling artifact of excessive electricity storage use.

arxiv-2201-06004.title: Element abundances in metal poor local star-forming galaxies constrained by the weak spectral lines
arxiv-2201-06004.creator: M. Contini
arxiv-2201-06004.description: Abstract We have collected from different surveys some significant spectroscopic data observed from star-forming galaxies in the local Universe. The objects showing a relatively rich spectrum in number of lines from different elements were selected in order to constrain the models. In particular, we looked at the relatively weak lines such as [OIII]4363, HeII4686, HeI4471 and HeI5876.

arxiv-2202-13795.title: A review on geometric constraint solving Journal: jcde DOI: xxxxxxx
arxiv-2202-13795.creator: Qiang Zou, Zhihong Tang, Hsi-Yung Feng, Shuming Gao, Chenchu Zhou, Yusheng Liu
arxiv-2202-13795.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Qiang Zou, Zhihong Tang, Hsi-Yung Feng, Shuming Gao, Chenchu Zhou, Yusheng Liu. This paper presents a comprehensive review of geometric constraint solving in parametric computer-aided design (CAD), with the major focus on its advances in the last 15 years. Geometric constraint solving can date back to the very first CAD prototype, Sketchpad, in the 1960s, but serious research studies were carried out only after parametric CAD was introduced in the late 1980s.

arxiv-2308-07858.title: Tilt-induced charge localisation in phosphide antiperovskite photovoltaics
arxiv-2308-07858.creator: Ruiqi Wu, Alex M. Ganose
arxiv-2308-07858.description: Abstract Antiperovskites are a rich family of compounds with applications in battery cathodes, superconductors, solid-state lighting, and catalysis. Recently, a novel series of antimonide phosphide antiperovskites ( A 3 ​ SbP \text{\text{$A$}}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\vphantom{\text{2}}\smash[t]{\text{3}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{3}}\text{}}\text{SbP} , where A A = Ca, Sr, Ba) were proposed as candidate photovoltaic absorbers due to their ideal band gaps, small effective masses and strong optical absorption.

arxiv-2405-03360.title: Embedded Distributed Inference of Deep Neural Networks: A Systematic Review
arxiv-2405-03360.creator: Federico Nicolás Peccia, Oliver Bringmann
arxiv-2405-03360.description: Abstract . Embedded distributed inference of Neural Networks has emerged as a promising approach for deploying machine-learning models on resource-constrained devices in an efficient and scalable manner. The inference task is distributed across a network of embedded devices, with each device contributing to the overall computation by performing a portion of the workload.

arxiv-2408-01424.title: Generalised Circuit Partitioning for Distributed Quantum Computing
arxiv-2408-01424.creator: Felix Burt, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Kin K. Leung
arxiv-2408-01424.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Felix Burt, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Kin K. Leung. Distributed quantum computing (DQC) is a new paradigm aimed at scaling up quantum computing via the interconnection of smaller quantum processing units (QPUs). Shared entanglement allows teleportation of both states and gates between QPUs. This leads to an attractive horizontal scaling of quantum processing power, which comes at the expense of the additional time and noise introduced by entanglement sharing protocols.

arxiv-2409-00941.title: Frequency-Position-Fluid Antenna Array for Ultra-dense Connectivity in Terahertz Beamforming Systems
arxiv-2409-00941.creator: Heyin Shen 1 \textrm{Heyin Shen}^{1} , Chong Han 1 \textrm{Chong Han}^{1} , Hao Liu 2 \textrm{Hao Liu}^{2} , and Tao Yang 2 \textrm{Tao Yang}^{2}
arxiv-2409-00941.description: Abstract The position-fluid antenna (PFA) architecture has become one of the appealing technologies to support ubiquitous connectivity demand in next-generation wireless systems. Specifically, allowing the antenna to adjust its physical position to one of the predefined ports within a fixed region can introduce additional spatial diversity and improve the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR).

arxiv-2412-06002.title: BMS particles
arxiv-2412-06002.creator: Xavier Bekaert, Laura Donnay, Yannick Herfray
arxiv-2412-06002.description: Abstract We construct wavefunctions for unitary irreducible representations (UIRs) of the Bondi-Metzner-Sachs (BMS) group, i.e. BMS particles, and show that they describe quantum superpositions of (Poincaré) particles propagating on inequivalent gravity vacua. This follows from reconsidering McCarthy’s classification of BMS group UIRs through a unique, Lorentz-invariant but non-linear, decomposition of supermomenta into hard and soft pieces.

pmc-11465517.title: Rapid evolution of mitochondrion-related genes in haplodiploid arthropods
pmc-11465517.creator: Yiyuan Li, Gregg W C Thomas, Stephen Richards, Robert M Waterhouse, Xin Zhou, Michael E Pfrender
pmc-11465517.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundMitochondrial genes and nuclear genes cooperate closely to maintain the functions of mitochondria, especially in the oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) pathway. However, mitochondrial genes among arthropod lineages have dramatic evolutionary rate differences. Haplodiploid arthropods often show fast-evolving mitochondrial genes. One hypothesis predicts that the small effective population size of haplodiploid species could enhance the effect of genetic drift leading to higher substitution rates in mitochondrial and nuclear genes.

pmc-11692074.title: MEMORY ISSUES IN RETROSPECTIVE LIFE HISTORY SURVEYS: DO QUESTION TYPE AND TOPIC MATTER?
pmc-11692074.creator: Wenqing Qian, Wenshan Yu, Mary Beth Ofstedal, Jacqui Smith, Marina Larkina, Amanda Sonnega
pmc-11692074.description: Collecting retrospective information from the older population is critical yet challenging, and especially in self-administered surveys. Older adults may have difficulty retrieving autobiographical memories, navigating skip patterns in mail surveys, or using the complex technology often required for web surveys. These factors may lead to potential data quality concerns.

pmc-12568406.title: The synergistic interaction of vitamin D deficiency and insomnia on dizziness-related handicap in patients with benign paroxysmal positional vertigo
pmc-12568406.creator: Bo Tang, Minghua Luo, Dan Wang, Yuqin He, Chuang Zhang, Xiaojun Yu
pmc-12568406.description: BackgroundWhile insomnia and vitamin D deficiency are known risk factors for BPPV, their interactive effect on the dizziness-related handicap is unknown. Given that both may independently promote pro-inflammatory states, a synergistic interaction is biologically plausible. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate both the independent and interactive effects of insomnia and 25-OH-D levels on the dizziness-related handicap in BPPV patients.

pmc-12577165.title: A mediastinal eosinophilic adenoma misdiagnosed as an esophageal stromal tumor: A case report
pmc-12577165.creator: Siyu Chen, Jusi Wang, Ning Ao, Shouyin Di, Hui Wu, Taiqian Gong
pmc-12577165.description: BackgroundEosinophilic adenoma, a benign tumor characterized by eosinophilic cell proliferation, typically arises in endocrine organs such as the thyroid or parathyroid glands. Ectopic parathyroid eosinophilic adenoma is rare and may mimic other mediastinal pathologies, leading to diagnostic challenges.Case presentationWe present a case of a 54-year-old woman with a one-year history of dysphagia.

pmc-12705823.title: Efficacy and safety of home-based transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) on patients with depressive disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials
pmc-12705823.creator: Reza Moshfeghinia, Sanaz Bordbar, Yasamin Roointanpour, Melika Arab Bafrani, Mohammadreza Shalbafan
pmc-12705823.description: Depressive disorders, including major depressive disorder, impair functioning and affect 280 million people globally. Traditional treatments are not fully effective. Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) offers a noninvasive alternative. Home-based tDCS shows promise for treating depression, requiring systematic review to assess its reliability and efficacy.

pmc-13364391.creator: Giuseppina Augimeri, Domenica Mazza, Luca Gelsomino, Ines Barone, Cinzia Giordano, Stefania Catalano, Carlo Adornetto, Maria Stefania Sinicropi, Daniela Bonofiglio

In this context, mindful eating and adherence to the Mediterranean Diet have emerged as models promoting beneficial health outcomes, whereas orthorexia nervosa, characterized by an obsessive focus on eating healthy foods, often leads to dietary inadequacies.

pmc-13675512.title: Bridging Critical Care and Mental Health: Jordanian ICU Nurses' Self‐Reported Knowledge, Skills, Attitudes and Confidence in Caring for Patients With Mental Illness
pmc-13675512.creator: Ahmad B. Al‐Rawashdeh, Mahmoud Abdel Hameed Shahin, Samia Eaid Elgazzar, Ateya Megahed Ibrahim, Rasha Mohammed Hussien

Understanding nurses' knowledge, skills and attitudes toward mental health care is essential to improving the quality and safety of care.
